decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is the firm's core business, and lines launched only a year ago are normally kept to build distribution and recover development costs.
A comfort insole complements the shoe range at low cost and supports accessory sales, though it gets only modest visibility on the website.
Supportive insoles fit the firm's foot-measurement and tailored-solution offering, so keeping this one is cheap and strategically sensible.
The ergonomic series has its own dedicated page and matches the firm's innovation and comfort focus, which signals strong commitment.
Firefighter boots serve a specialised niche with certification investment already made, making early withdrawal unlikely.
Featured on the home page, the moulded insole is clearly a promoted product the firm intends to grow.
